title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E8 — Nurses Wild
The paramedics hold a demonstration for student nurses, one of whom interests Gage; the hospital staff saves a robber and his victim.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E9 — Publicity Hound
Gage resents media attention given to a paramedic (Gary Crosby) from another squad; Brackett clashes with a tycoon over a diagnosis.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E10 — Weird Wednesday
The paramedics and hospital staff deal with a stubborn elderly woman (Jeanette Nolan), a parachutist in a tree and other odd cases.

title: Emergency!
description:
S1 E11 — Dilemma
Gage and DeSoto rescue an elderly couple from an elevator crash; Brackett berates a forgetful student nurse; a girl irritates Gage.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E15 — The Big Squeeze
The team works from a pub to stop a loan shark (Joseph Sirola) from terrorizing small businesses; guest Wings Hauser.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E16 — Champ!
To stop a mobster's takeover of local boxing events, Hannibal sets up a syndicate with B.A. fighting as Volcano Johnson.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E17 — Skins
Infatuated B.A. volunteers the team to help a Kenyan game warden (Daphne Maxwell) find the poachers who killed her brother.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E18 — Road Games
As payment for a debt, the mob demands a reformed gambler (Jason Evers) sign over a foster home he and his daughter run.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E19 — Moving Targets
Rebels pursue an Arabian princess (Sue Kiel) the team is escorting to her wedding; guests John Saxon, Frank Annese.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E20 — Knights of the Road
The team confronts a greedy towing-service operator (Don Stroud) pressuring a one-truck competitor to fold.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E21 — Waste 'Em!
The team battles a garbage-disposal company sabotaging its competitor and dumping toxic waste into city sewers.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E22 — Bounty
A lovely veterinarian (Wendy Fulton) saves Murdock after bounty hunters kidnap him; guest Bill McKinney.

title: The A-Team
description:
S3 E23 — Beverly Hills Assault
Murdock takes up painting and Face becomes a critic to bust a ring of Beverly Hills art thieves; guests Lloyd Bochner, Dennis Franz.

title: The Incredible Hulk
description:
S5 E1 — The Phenom
Banner and a baseball writer try to save a pitching prodigy's career.
